intro: UrbanVille @ Woodlands is an HDB project in Woodlands. Our project file describes it as reported complete and carries a third-party 2026 completion note, but this entry is not officially confirmed. Official HDB roadshow resources, checked in our file on 7 November 2026, do not confirm a project-wide TOP or key date, and key appointments are unconfirmed. Unit counts and any completion year are therefore left out of the facts below. If you have an HDB key letter, use that. We will not publish a tracker year as if HDB had issued it. This page sets out what is on file and how to plan your UrbanVille @ Woodlands renovation.

sections.heading: Planning your UrbanVille @ Woodlands interior
sections.text:
Woodlands is a mature northern town, and owners who are close to keys — or who already have them — usually want a first fit-out that works as a long stay: a fitted kitchen, full-height wardrobes, an entry shoe cabinet, and a living-room storage wall, rather than a temporary arrangement of loose furniture. Maison specifies this as built-in carpentry, not as IKEA-style furniture, and we will design from your approved plan only. No official floor plan is on file, so typologies are not listed, and we will not invent a typical UrbanVille layout.

Woodgrove Ascent, Woodlands South Plains, Woodgrove Edge and Woodgrove Acres are the other Woodlands HDB pages in this batch; Acres is a June 2026 BTO launch and is years away from keys. Norwood Grand, already live, and Wynwood Grand, packed earlier, are nearby private and EC links in the same town. We will not invent walking times to Woodlands town or to any MRT station. Check your block, facing and the HDB renovation rules before you plan blinds, a bench or any hacking.

After keys, inspect defects and obtain the HDB renovation permit before fabrication. A moderate carpentry scope is often planned at about six to ten weeks on site after access and approvals — an editorial allowance, not a promise. WhatsApp Maison with your approved plan and any key letter you have. We are not affiliated with HDB.

faq.a: Yes, for the usual HDB renovation works. After keys, inspect defects, then apply for the permit with a registered contractor before carpentry is fabricated.
